_about: Map vision offer-rule evaluation (DIC-2138). Each question is sent to Map Buddy as the first turn of a fresh conversation about the parcel below. 'expect' is what Map Buddy should do about map vision: 'none' (answer from data, no offer, no look), 'offer' (exactly one offer_map_look, no look), or 'look' (look_at_map). A look where an offer was expected counts as a failure: it spends money the user didn't agree to.
